title:
Namespace for all types used for {@link MlModel} health calculation.
Model health is a single value representing the performance of a model. Unlike the metric results produced by
{@link MlModel.Monitor}, there is only one model health for a single model. That being said, model health is
often calculated as an aggregation over the metric results produced by {@link MlModel.Monitor}.
name: MlModel.HealthCalc
